title.zh-CN: 青年反复头晕与后来出现的神经症状
title.en: Recurrent dizziness followed by evolving neurological symptoms

summary.zh-CN: 初次神经检查无明确阳性表现，后续发作与连续影像改变需放在同一时间线上理解。
summary.en: Initial examination is unrevealing; later episodes and serial imaging changes need chronological interpretation.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: ECTRIMS current McDonald criteria page, checked 2026-10-28; confirms 2024 revisions published 2025; no claim that this incomplete historical dataset fulfils every modern criterion.

finding.en: Examination and neurophysiology were unrevealing, EDSS 0; blood pressure 110/65 mmHg and temperature 36.9°C.

text.zh-CN: 脑MRI未见明显异常，仅颈髓点状异常信号，无明显强化；常规化验无明显异常。
text.en: Brain MRI was unrevealing, with only a punctate cervical cord signal abnormality and no clear enhancement; routine laboratory tests were unremarkable.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。

note.zh-CN: 调阅原报告已完成的检查；不在实景模式中重新施行检查。
note.en: Review of an investigation already completed in the source; it is not repeated in in-world mode.

text.zh-CN: 约10个月后乏力、视物模糊、听力下降，EDSS 2，左室旁环形强化病灶；治疗35天后强化消失。再约9个月后症状加重伴抑郁表现，左颞叶等新增六个病灶。脑脊液仅记为未见明显异常，未给寡克隆带等详细结果。
text.en: About ten months later weakness, blurred vision and reduced hearing accompanied EDSS 2 and a ring-enhancing left periventricular lesion; enhancement resolved after 35 days of treatment. About nine months later worsening with depressive features accompanied six new lesions including left temporal white matter. CSF was described only as unremarkable without detailed oligoclonal-band results.

text.en: The source diagnosed an acute relapse of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis after the third episode; long-term treatment and outcomes were not supplied.

hint.en: Clarify presentation, progression, associated symptoms and relevant history.

hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

hint.zh-CN: 将检查结果放回时间线；比较能够解释全部证据的方向。
hint.en: Place findings in their timeline and compare explanations for the complete evidence.

title.en: Plan care and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 区分已报告处置与当前教学计划，核对后续变化。
hint.en: Distinguish reported care from the educational plan and review subsequent changes.

guidance.en: Plan care and review the outcome

prompt.en: How should the first MRI be interpreted?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 非特异症状与单个不典型信号需要随访和鉴别，尚不足直接确诊
text.en: Nonspecific symptoms and one atypical signal require follow-up and differential assessment rather than immediate certainty

feedback.zh-CN: 保留异常线索，但不把单点信号等同完整诊断。
feedback.en: Retain the clue without equating one signal with a complete diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 脑MRI无异常说明今后不可能有神经病
text.en: An unrevealing brain MRI excludes future neurological disease

feedback.zh-CN: 颈髓线索和后续临床变化仍有意义。
feedback.en: The cord finding and later clinical evolution remain relevant.

text.zh-CN: 已能凭一点信号确诊多发性硬化
text.en: One signal definitively establishes multiple sclerosis

feedback.zh-CN: 需要综合临床、分布、时序及替代解释。
feedback.en: Clinical features, distribution, timing and alternatives require integration.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 新部位病灶和复发构成时空演变证据，支持原报告的复发缓解型判断
text.en: New lesions and relapses provide temporal and spatial evolution supporting the report’s relapsing-remitting interpretation

feedback.zh-CN: 序列比较强于单张影像；现代标准所需其他资料仍有缺口。
feedback.en: Serial comparison is stronger than a single scan, while modern assessment still has gaps.

text.zh-CN: 强化消失就表示永久治愈
text.en: Loss of enhancement means permanent cure

feedback.zh-CN: 强化只反映部分活动性，之后有新增病灶。
feedback.en: Enhancement reflects only part of activity and later lesions appeared.

text.zh-CN: 笼统脑脊液正常等于已测所有抗体和标志物
text.en: An unremarkable CSF statement means all biomarkers were tested

feedback.zh-CN: 未列具体结果不能补写寡克隆带或抗体。
feedback.en: Unlisted oligoclonal bands or antibodies cannot be invented.

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 由神经免疫专科按现行标准重审影像、临床发作及相似疾病，讨论长期治疗
text.en: Neuroimmunology review should apply current criteria to imaging, attacks and mimics, then discuss long-term therapy

feedback.zh-CN: 2024修订标准已于2025发表，旧2005阈值不能作为唯一现行规则。
feedback.en: The 2024 revisions were published in 2025; historical 2005 thresholds are not the sole current rules.

text.zh-CN: 只按文中2005条款机械确诊
text.en: Diagnose mechanically using only the article’s 2005 clauses

feedback.zh-CN: 标准已更新，且原始资料未完整覆盖其要求。
feedback.en: Criteria have changed and the source dataset is incomplete.

text.zh-CN: 没有明显查体异常就不安排随访
text.en: Avoid follow-up without obvious examination signs

feedback.zh-CN: 连续影像和复发症状提示需要主动复核。
feedback.en: Serial imaging and recurrent symptoms warrant reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 使用现行专科标准复核并排除相似病，不从单张MRI过度确诊
text.en: Use current specialist criteria and assess mimics without overdiagnosing from a single MRI

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明首诊证据有限。；承认缺少完整神经定位、寡克隆带、AQP4/MOG及长期治疗资料。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Initial evidence was limited.; acknowledge Complete neurological localisation, oligoclonal bands, AQP4/MOG and long-term therapy data are missing. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 病例展示连续临床和MRI证据如何逐步支持脱髓鞘疾病判断。
conclusion.en: The case illustrates how serial clinical and MRI evidence progressively supports a demyelinating interpretation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 后续新增病灶改变判断强度。
keyReasoning.en: New later lesions strengthen the interpretation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 旧标准和缺失检验必须标明。
keyReasoning.en: Historical criteria and missing tests must be explicit.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不将临床症状自动称为影像孤立综合征。
teachingPoints.en: Do not automatically label a symptomatic case radiologically isolated syndrome.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 强化消退不是疾病消失。
teachingPoints.en: Loss of enhancement is not disappearance of disease.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少完整神经定位、寡克隆带、AQP4/MOG及长期治疗资料。
unknowns.en: Complete neurological localisation, oligoclonal bands, AQP4/MOG and long-term therapy data are missing.
